basis: Re-ran every evidence command independently. `grep -n 'Pricing Pipeline' -A3 CLAUDE.md` reproduces the exact quoted text at CLAUDE.md:137 ('DH ... is the sole price source'). `grep -n CardLadder cmd/slabledger/init_services.go` shows initializeCardLadder at line 99; `wc -l internal/adapters/scheduler/cardladder_refresh.go` = 525; routes.go:65-71 register 7 /api/admin/cardladder/* routes; loader.go:176 reads CARDLADDER_REFRESH_ENABLED. `sed -n '1,15p' internal/domain/liquidation/comp_price.go` confirms ComputeCompPrice(comps, clValueCents) at line 9, independent of DHPriceProvider. `git ls-files internal/domain/dhpricing/` returns service.go/service_test.go/types.go, unmentioned in CLAUDE.md. Every cited file:line resolves to the claimed content.

`go list ./internal/domain/... | grep -iE 'cards|favorites'` returns nothing (no such packages), matching the finding. `go list ./internal/domain/... | sed 's#.*/domain/##' | sort` returns 25 entries including demand, dhevents, dhpricing, liquidation, psacampaign, pricing/lookup — none of which appear in CLAUDE.md's domain tree (lines 36-58), which instead lists the nonexistent cards/ (line 47) and favorites/ (line 50). Cross-checked against the audit's own verified-context note (7 repo interfaces, 25 domain packages) which agrees.

`find internal/adapters/clients -maxdepth 1 -type d` and `ls internal/adapters/clients/` both confirm the real set: azureai, cardladder, dh, dhlisting, dhprice, google, httpx, psa, psaportal — no pricelookup, no tcgdex. CLAUDE.md:63-64 lists pricelookup/ and tcgdex/ under adapters/clients/, both absent. The real PriceLookup wrapper lives at internal/domain/pricing/lookup/adapter.go (git ls-files confirms), not under adapters/clients/. CLAUDE.md's tree also omits cardladder/, dh/, dhlisting/, psa/, psaportal/, all of which exist.
what_the_finding_got_wrong: The finding's second evidence command reports 'd555333b removed internal/adapters/clients/tcgdex' as the output of `git log --diff-filter=D --oneline -- internal/adapters/clients/tcgdex | head -3`. Running that exact command returns a different commit: `474072bd remove: reduce surface area — card search, watchlists, picks, orphaned tables (#152)`. Commit d555333b is real but is an unrelated dead-code-removal commit (#154) that does not touch tcgdex. This detail is fabricated/mismatched, but it is supporting color, not the actionable claim — the directory-tree drift itself (pricelookup/tcgdex listed but absent; 5 real dirs omitted) is independently and fully verified, and the acceptance criteria (`ls` output matching CLAUDE.md's tree) do not depend on the commit hash at all.

basis: CLAUDE.md:125-133 lists exactly Required/DH/AI/Auth/Schedulers (PRICE_REFRESH_ENABLED only) with no CardLadder group. .env.example:212-213 has CARDLADDER_REFRESH_ENABLED="true" and CARDLADDER_REFRESH_HOUR="4" live (uncommented); line 218 has CL_SEARCH_URL as a commented example. loader.go:176 reads CARDLADDER_REFRESH_ENABLED live via envBool. All claims reproduce exactly.

The finding's subject.identity and claim both cite 'CLAUDE.md:145' as where the '`make check` — runs lint + architecture import check + file size check' text lives. Reading CLAUDE.md:145 directly shows a completely unrelated line: '- Service mocks for each sub-package: `MockArbitrageService`, `MockPortfolioService`, etc.' The actual `make check` description sentence is at CLAUDE.md:167 (confirmed via `grep -n "make check" CLAUDE.md`). The Makefile side of the evidence (`grep -n -A5 '^check:' Makefile`) does reproduce correctly — check: lint / check-imports.sh / check-file-size.sh / check-playwright-version.sh, at Makefile:146 as cited — confirming the Makefile does run a 4th, undocumented script. But per VERIFIER-BRIEF, a finding citing a line that does not contain the quoted text is refuted even when the underlying complaint is valid, because a fixer following the citation lands on the wrong sentence in CLAUDE.md.
what_the_finding_got_wrong: Cites CLAUDE.md:145 for the 'make check' description; the real location is CLAUDE.md:167. Line 145 is an unrelated bullet about mock patterns. The underlying complaint (Makefile's check target runs check-playwright-version.sh, which CLAUDE.md's description omits) is independently true, but the finding as written would send a fixer to the wrong line.

what_the_finding_got_wrong: The 'zero Go references remain outside one stale comment' sub-claim cites `git grep -ci marketmovers internal cmd | grep -v ':0'` as producing 'cmd/slabledger/init_services.go:4: 1 (a stale comment only)'. Running that exact command instead returns five migration files (000001, 000003, 000005 — all legitimate table-creation/rollback SQL, not stale references) and does NOT include cmd/slabledger/init_services.go, because that file's comment reads 'Market Movers' (two words, space-separated), which the single-word substring 'marketmovers' never matches. The underlying claim is still true — a broader search (`git grep -in 'Market Movers|MarketMovers' -- '*.go'` excluding tests) confirms init_services.go:4 is indeed the only non-migration Go reference, and `git grep -n 'mm_value_cents|mm_trend_pct|mm_sales_30d' -- '*.go'` returns nothing — but the specific command/output pair in the finding's evidence does not reproduce as written. This does not affect either acceptance criterion, both of which concern only docs/SCHEMA.md's migration-number citation and its documentation of dropped tables, which are independently solid.
